**Templates** shows the ready-made solutions that you can add to your workspace. A Template is one file that holds a solution and everything it needs.

![The Templates screen: the title and a line that says "Cases already built: try one as it is, or start from it and make it yours", the search field, the button Import from file, and one card per Template with its picture, its description, its author and what it contains](images/templates.jpg)

## What you need

An internet connection on the machine where Agentivity runs. The list comes from the Agentivity marketplace.

## The list

Each card is a Template. It shows a picture, the name, a short description, its author and what it contains (for example "1 team · 9 agents · 5 data tables", and the Knowledge Bases too, such as "1 team · 4 agents · 1 knowledge base").

- **Search templates** finds a Template.
- **Import from file**, at the top right, adds a Template that you received as a file.

## The window of a Template

Select a card to open it.

![The window of the Template CV Screening: its picture, its name, its author, its version and its language, what it contains and what it needs, and the tabs About, How it is built and What it contains](images/template-detail.jpg)

The window shows:

- the name, the author, the version and the language, and the button **Import**;
- what the Template contains and what it needs (for example "A model connection", when the Template needs an AI model);
- the tab **About**: its description and the author's website;
- the tab **How it is built**: a drawing of the solution, before you import anything;
- the tab **What it contains**: the list of its parts.

**Import** adds the Template to your workspace. The cross at the top right closes the window and goes back to the list.

## Import from a file

When you received a Template as a file:

1. Select **Import from file**, at the top right.
2. Choose the file.
3. Select **Import**.

## After an import

The import creates new copies: nothing you already have is changed. See [Try a ready-made solution](/docs/getting-started/try-a-ready-made-solution/) for the model connection of the imported agents.
